title: Plastic
text: Plastic. Plastic plastic and more plastic..absolutely ridiculous to spend $18 on a plastic ice tray..sign of the times and our own stupidity

product_metadata.title: 2 Pack Ice Cube Tray with Lid and Bin for Freezer, Easy Release 55 Nugget Ice Tray with Cover, Storage Container, Scoop. Perfect Small Ice Cube Maker Tray & Mold. Flexable Durable Plastic, BPA Free
features: Ice Tray with lid and Bin：Our 3 in 1 Bundle includes 2 stackable ice cube trays, 1 storage container and 1 ice scooper. Freeze your ice and dump into ice bin for easy access.

Safe and Convenient: The ice tray and bin scoop are made of food-grade plastic,BPA-free, Provide healthy for babies, children and adults.The lid can fit well with the ice tray. Keeps ice fresh and sanitary by preventing ice from absorbing freezer odors.The lid and the bucket can be a good storage box.

Easy to Release : The ice cube tray made with highly-elastic plastic, Flexible Ice cubes release easily with just a twist. After removing the tray from the freezer, you can empty the tray immediately and make ice again.

Perfect Mini Ice Cubes: The ice cube tray makes 110 ice cubes one time go.The compact ice cube maker bucket is 10.4*6.2*2.8 inches and holds 3 trays of cubes while you make more.Our Ice cube trays can making for coffee,cocktails,Jelly, chocolate, baby food at any time.Perfect for RV refrigerator and Home Fridges.
Space-Saving Ice Tray with lid and Bin: Allows for stacking multiple trays.In the process of use, the shape of the ice lattice is stable, and the water is not easy to spill out.
